whyItMatters: Debug mode exposes tracebacks, interactive consoles, or verbose errors to anyone who can reach the service, turning minor flaws into information disclosure or code execution.
actions: Read the debug flag from an environment variable that defaults to false.
Fail startup when debug is true outside local development.
Re-run a SAST scan after the fix and confirm DPK-SAST-015 is no longer observed.
verification: The finding disappears on rescan and production starts with debug disabled.
